# Third-party references

Do not copy external repositories wholesale into this directory.

When code or data is imported, record the upstream repository and exact commit, upstream license, files copied or adapted, and local modifications.

Primary references currently under study:

- amd/mini-isp
- cruxopen/openISP
- QiuJueqin/fast-openISP
- 10x-Engineers/Infinite-ISP
- mushfiqulalam/isp
